nodes.name: Representer.java
nodes.summary: Patched copy of SnakeYAML's Representer placed in the original package to override bean representation/tag handling, required so ShardingSphere custom YAML tags (!SHARDING, !ENCRYPT) in sharding configs serialize correctly.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses the jar-override technique: a class in package org.yaml.snakeyaml.representer shadows the library class on the classpath to fix ShardingSphere YAML tag handling.

nodes.name: Representer

nodes.name: checkGlobalTag
nodes.summary: Recursively rewrites tags on collection/array member nodes so nested generic types resolve to the correct YAML tag instead of the global default.

nodes.name: resetTag
nodes.summary: Resets a node's tag to a concrete class tag, handling enum types specially.
